```{r}
# load the targets pipeline in here
# You should make sure all the targets are named
# so that targets can identify what targets are required in order
# to run the pipeline.
# i.e., do not use 
## tar_load_everything()
## tar_load(everything())
## tar_load(starts_with())
# As these will mean your quarto report may not render, since targets cannot
# identify what targets need to be up to date for the report to render
tar_load(
  c(
    air_may,
    air_fit,
    air_augmented,
    air_coefs,
    air_glance
  )
)
```
